# ReadWriteFlash QC

**Author:** siem<br/>
**Platforms:** BREW

<div className="screenshot">

![ReadWriteFlash QC: screenshot 1](./readwriteflash-qc/img/readwriteflash-qc.png)

</div>

ReadWriteFlash QC works with Qualcomm phone factory and NV parameters. The program allows you to:

- Read and write the KLF byte;
- Write the IMEI;
- Read and write the Bluetooth address;
- Read and write the variant name;
- Unlock the service code and write it to NV;
- Switch the phone to FTM and power it off;
- Test the LED and camera flash.

After installation, the contents of `Copy_Pack` must be copied to the program folder, replacing the files.
